speaker: Doctor

speaker: Patient
text: I noticed swelling in my neck over the last few days. It does not hurt, but it feels enlarged and fixed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Hodgkin Lymphoma. The combination of painless, fixed supraclavicular lymphadenopathy, "B symptoms" (fever, night sweats, weight loss), and elevated WBCs is highly suggestive of this malignancy, particularly given the location of the node.
